note: The standard simulation applied to every twin (lengths in mm unless the key says m; angles in deg; times in s).

sim.note: mjOption is reset to MuJoCo's defaults first (density, viscosity, wind, magnetic, flags, o_* overrides), then these values are applied. Gravity points along -z of the support's top frame (support_frame), whatever the twin's own world axes are.

contact.note: every colliding geom gets these values, so every pair touches with sliding friction 0.6, torsional 0.005 and rolling 0.0001; visual geoms (contype = conaffinity = 0) stay non-colliding

kinematic.note: held things get this armature on their dofs (then mj_setConst) and have qpos / qvel written before every step; every other dof has no armature, damping or friction loss, every joint no stiffness, every body no gravity compensation, every geom no surface velocity, adhesion or fluid coefficients

settle.note: the settle blows up when the state becomes non-finite, MuJoCo reports a warning, or inside the window a thing moves faster than explode_speed_m_s or further than explode_disp_mm

pieces.note: a sphere, capsule, cylinder or ellipsoid becomes a circumscribed polyhedron: the primitive lies inside it and the two surfaces are at most primitive_max_gap_mm apart
